name: detoxcellence-exposure-index
title: Detoxcellence Exposure Index
description: Everyday products and habits rated for avoidable exposure burden, with the studies behind each rating.

fields.name: id
fields.description: URL slug of the entry; the page is /exposure/<id>.html.

fields.name: category
fields.description: One of Water, Air, Food, Kitchen, Plastics, Personal Care, Home, Environment.

fields.name: context
fields.description: What the entry means in practice.

fields.name: hazard
fields.description: Editorial rating 0-10: toxicity of the associated chemical(s).

fields.name: exposure
fields.description: Editorial rating 0-10: how much the average person is exposed through this source.

fields.name: persistence
fields.description: Editorial rating 0-10: how long the associated chemicals or particles linger in body and environment.

fields.name: detox_score
fields.description: Computed: 100 - 4.6*hazard - 3.4*exposure - 2.6*persistence, rounded, kept within 1-100. Higher is lower burden.

fields.name: band
fields.description: Computed from detox_score: Minimal 80-100, Low 60-79, Moderate 40-59, High 20-39, Severe 1-19.

fields.name: evidence_strength
fields.description: Editorial grade of the evidence, 1 emerging, 2 moderate, 3 strong. Not used in the score.

fields.name: swap
fields.description: A lower-exposure alternative, or a dash where none applies.

fields.name: studies
fields.description: Number of studies recorded behind the ratings.

fields.name: inputs_sourced
fields.description: How many of the three ratings (0-3) cite at least one study.

fields.name: study_ids
fields.description: Semicolon-separated identifiers (doi:... or pmid:...) of those studies; full records are in the JSON export.

fields.name: source_urls
fields.description: Semicolon-separated agency or web sources for the entry, if any.

resources.name: exposures-full
resources.description: The source rows verbatim (including every study record and source) with a dataset-level provenance statement.
